description: Creates a whoisbrowsing site with no sign-up and returns its script tag (snippet), one watch link per website, a one-time claim link, a terms sentence for the human and the next steps. Call it once per project; one site can hold several domains. Never write the watch or claim link into a file, commit or log.

domains.description: The websites the tag will run on: host[:port] (e.g. localhost:3000, example.com), or *.host for every subdomain (e.g. *.example.com). A scheme or path is stripped; a host is letters, digits, hyphens and dots (a non-ASCII domain in its xn-- form); www. is the same website as the bare domain; each website is watched separately.

name.description: A label for the site. Defaults to the first domain.

name: create_site

claimUrl.description: The one-time link that keeps the site in the human's account after signing in with Google. Expires after 30 days. Give it to the human right away; never write it into a file, commit or log.

installDocs.description: Where the tag goes for each platform.

next.description: What to do next, in order, in plain words.

siteId.description: The site ID: the data-site value in the snippet. Public, fine to commit.

snippet.description: The script tag to put on every page, unchanged.

terms.description: A sentence for the human, in the same reply as the two links: opening the watch link or keeping the script is agreeing to the Terms, and confirming they've read the Privacy page.

watchUrls.description: One watch link per website: the human's own site, opened with a private owner key in the #fragment. Give it to the human right away; never write it into a file, commit or log. Treat it like a password.

title: Create a whoisbrowsing site
